scope: Offline smali review of the original Graal Online Classic 1.8 DEX
method: The private classes.dex was disassembled with baksmali 2.5.2 and inspected by class and method. Raw smali is not redistributed.

behavior: Creates a WebView with the application context
Sets the legacy WebView PluginState to ON
Adds the view to its parent and stores it in webviewmap
Calls WebView.loadUrl with the supplied URL
No visible URL allowlist check appears in the reviewed method
Calls WebView.loadUrl with the supplied URL when the mapped view exists
Parses the supplied value with org.json.JSONArray
Reports a parsed result or an error to the resolver task
The static boolean field is explicitly false
Reports a FacebookDialogException to the listener

interpretation: The game activity has a JavaScript-enabled navigation surface with a native-supplied URL input.
The addJavascriptInterface bridge belongs to a separate Bolts app-link resolver and is limited to JSON metadata resolution in the reviewed code.
The reviewed Facebook WebDialog path rejects WebView certificate errors. It does not establish a Java SSL bypass.
The native connector uses an independent CyaSSL implementation and is not covered by the WebDialog result.
